title: RFID
summary: NFC/UHF scan, saved dumps, NTAG emulation and RFID tools
description: RFID 1.0 for CardputerZero: READ, SAVED, EMU and TOOLS workflows for M5 NFC CAP (SPI), M5 NFC Unit (IIC), PN532, PN532Killer and supported UHF readers. Manage saved dumps, write MFC dumps using compatible hardware/card modes, use MFKey32v2/MFKey64/Staticnested tools, and load JSON data for NTAG emulation. Hardware support varies per function. External RFID/NFC reader required. SPI MFC 1K encrypted emulation is experimental and disabled by default in 1.0: restart authentication regression remains unresolved.
